name: EasyPay
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 22 >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm alias default 22 >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 22 >/dev/null; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 22)/bin:$PATH"; node -v; npm install

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 22)/bin:$PATH"; npm run dev:api
terminals.description: EasyPay HTTP + SSE API server (in-memory store) on :8787

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 22)/bin:$PATH"; npm run dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server on :5173, proxies /api to :8787
